- Stand on as many plates as necessary, until the bar cant touch the floor, while your back is parallel to it
- Bar must touch upper abs each rep

- Use plates to elevate your heels
- focus on pushing your knees forward, not sitting down
- adjust the belt so you can go fulldepth

Deficit stifflegs:
- Stand on a plate while doing it to go further down
- Instead of increasing weight, you may increase RoM through inceease of elevation or even widening your grip
